summary: Bug fix verification completed for LOTR 5e Travel System. All 5 features/bugs tested and verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIX VERIFIED: startGlobalJourney() and startDayByDayJourney() now correctly use m.papeles?.includes('guia') instead of m.papel === 'guia' (lines 429, 476)
MAX_ROLES_PER_CHARACTER = 2 correctly enforced - dropdown shows '(2/2 papeles)' and disables selection
JourneyMiniMap component correctly renders map with origin (green) and destination (red) markers
Backend /api/travel/calculate-journey correctly returns origen_coords and destino_coords (lines 799-806)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All travel system bugs verified fixed: (1) Guide assignment bug fixed, (2) Max 2 roles per character working, (3) Mini-map displays with coordinates

FEATURE_4_MINI_MAP.description: Mini-mapa del viaje muestra recorte del mapa con la ruta

FEATURE_5_BACKEND_COORDS.evidence: Backend test verified: returns {x, y} coordinates for both origen and destino
